name: Drama and speech tuition
summary: How expat families evaluate drama, speech, and performing-arts tuition in Singapore — Trinity/LAMDA exam tracks, school audition prep, and confidence classes without overpaying for stage-school marketing.
body:
Drama and speech coaching covers confidence, public speaking, LAMDA/Trinity exam grades, and audition prep for school productions. It is distinct from clinical speech-language therapy for articulation or language disorders — wrong provider wastes a term.

## Match the goal
- **Confidence / communication** — small group drama games, presentation skills
- **Exam boards** — LAMDA, Trinity speech/drama grades with syllabus fees
- **Auditions** — monologues, singing crossover, international-school production prep
- **Accent/elocution** — clarify goals; avoid shaming multilingual kids

If a child has diagnosed speech delay or stuttering concerns, start with speech-language pathology, not drama class.

## Practical checks
Class size, performance pressure, and make-up rules for travel weeks matter. Exam tracks add entry fees and book costs — get the annual extras list. Watch whether coaches give actionable notes or only praise.

## How to choose
Trial before packages. Prefer teachers who can explain assessment criteria for your chosen board and who adapt material to bilingual households. For teens, ask about portfolio/interview support for arts electives without guaranteeing conservatory outcomes.

## Practical tip
Stack drama on lighter homework days. Recital costumes and photo packages are optional upsells — decline politely if budget is tight.
